llm.system_prompt: Some personal details in the user's message have been replaced with placeholders such as <NAME_1> or <PHONE_1>. Treat each placeholder as the real value: wherever that detail belongs in your answer, copy the placeholder exactly as written, including the angle brackets.

examples.title: Example 1 (clean)
examples.prompt: Write a short message to my landlord. I'm Minji Park from 41 Maple Street, and my heater is broken. He can call me at 010-2345-6789.
examples.masked_prompt: Write a short message to my landlord. I'm <NAME_1> from <ADDRESS_1>, and my heater is broken. He can call me at <PHONE_1>.
examples.masked_answer: Hi, this is <NAME_1> from <ADDRESS_1>. My heater is broken and needs repair. Please call me at <PHONE_1> when you can. Thank you.
examples.answer: Hi, this is Minji Park from 41 Maple Street. My heater is broken and needs repair. Please call me at 010-2345-6789 when you can. Thank you.
